tasks.description: Move the UR5e attachment site to a reachable target and hold.
Trace a 4 cm square in the UR5e attachment site's XY plane and return to start.
Move the UR5e attachment site upward by 5 cm, hold, and return to the home keyframe.
Visit three reachable attachment-site waypoints in the declared order.
Attempt an unreachable UR5e target, detect the failure, and return home without retrying.
